sampleValues.Seasonal Route & Camps: Follow volcanic thermal valleys north in spring and shelter in sunken basalt craters during the frost-gales.
sampleValues.Leadership & Clan Council: Each tent-ring elects a Voice-Bearer; major war decisions require unanimous stone-casting by the Seven Mothers.
sampleValues.Oral Songs, Myths & Battle Tactics: Star-maps are memorized as sung ballads; riders use whistling arrows to coordinate flanking maneuvers in dust storms.
sampleValues.Annual Great Gathering: The Red Eclipse Market at Oakhaven Sink, where settled kingdoms trade grain and iron for rare sky-silk.
